steps.en: Install LangChain and set a model provider's API key
steps.zh: 安装 LangChain，配好一家模型厂商的 API key

steps.en: Write each tool as a plain Python function with a docstring
steps.zh: 把每个工具写成带 docstring 的普通 Python 函数

steps.en: Create the agent from a model string, your tools and a system prompt, then invoke it
steps.zh: 用模型字符串、工具和系统提示词创建 agent，然后调用它

steps.en: Translates the messages for that provider and sends them to the model
steps.zh: 把消息翻译成该厂商的格式，发给模型

steps.en: Runs each tool the model asks for, feeds the result back, repeats until a final answer
steps.zh: 模型要调哪个工具就执行哪个，结果喂回去，循环到给出最终答案

component.zh: 跑在 LangGraph 上的 agent 循环

value.en: A tool-using agent you can move between model providers by changing one string, without re-coding the loop
value.zh: 一个会用工具的 agent，换模型厂商只改一个字符串，循环不用重写

sources: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain#quickstart (uv add langchain, model strings like openai:gpt-5.5)
https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langchain/quickstart.md (Build a basic agent: def get_weather(city: str) -> str, create_agent(model=..., tools=[get_weather], system_prompt=...), agent.invoke)
